_comment: What each `sees` key gives a role, mirroring linkdown/agents.py build_view(). A pytest fails if build_view gains or loses a key without this file changing. `shown` says whether the published audit record contains the data, so the site can show it.

links.label: International link status (id, label, up or down)

capacity.label: Total capacity to each cloud region

service.label: Service settings, including its AI endpoint and where case files are stored

service_traffic.label: Traffic for the government AI service only

demand_classes.label: Names of the demand classes (no figures)

record_sets.label: Case-file record sets and their location
